verdict.label: BEARISH — Both Formal Triggers Fired; Moonshot II
verdict.headline: S&P 500 closes below 7,460 as WTI settles $82.49; Moonshot AI Kimi K3 delivers a second DeepSeek shock
verdict.rationale_short: Both primary STEP ASIDE → BEARISH trip wires activated simultaneously on Friday: SPX closed 7,457 (below the 7,460 formal support trigger) and WTI settled $82.49 (first formal breach of the $80 trip wire). A second DeepSeek-class shock arrived mid-session — Moonshot AI's Kimi K3, a 2.8-trillion-parameter open-weight model priced at $15/M output tokens vs. $50/M for US frontier models, undermined the AI capex demand thesis for GPU vendors. September hike probability reversed from 38% (morning post-CPI level) to approximately 69% on the oil surge. VIX closed 17.76 — below the 18 trigger — and NVDA held its $195 hard stop, preventing a high-conviction BEARISH call; medium conviction reflects the two formal triggers alongside meaningful non-breach in secondary indicators.

bear_case: Counter-thesis: the formal trigger breaches — SPX at 7,457 and WTI at $82.49 — occurred on a Friday, a characteristically low-volume session with mechanically exaggerated moves. SPX is only 3 points below the 7,460 trigger — within a normal half-day swing. WTI's $82.49 settlement is the first formal breach after two consecutive near-misses; the oil market is notoriously volatile around geopolitical events, and prior Iran escalation rounds produced 48-hour spikes that reversed entirely. NVDA's $203.31 close held the $195 hard stop — the most critical AI-cycle sentinel is intact. BTC Gate 2 at $62,000 is intact. Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 parallels the DeepSeek January 2025 announcement, which produced a single-day panic before the AI infrastructure thesis recovered fully within three weeks — the infrastructure build argument proved durable against cost-reduction narratives. June CPI 0.0% MoM and PPI –0.3% are structural disinflation that don't reverse on a single oil week. If weekend diplomacy produces any Iran de-escalation signal and WTI gaps below $79 Sunday, the BEARISH call will have marked the weekly panic low. Invalidation: If WTI falls below $79 by Monday open AND SPX closes above 7,480 with VIX below 17, the BEARISH verdict is wrong and STEP ASIDE resumes.
